_comment: Certification state per market for SINTEL. Sintel is CC BY 3.0 and was
never submitted for theatrical classification anywhere, so the states
here model what a commercial title carries rather than claiming real
certificates. They are declared in this file, reviewable in a diff, and
master_sha256 is the cut a certificate was granted against. Re-cutting
invalidates it, which is the same hash comparison every other staleness
question in this system reduces to.

certificates.note: Submitted 2026-08-30; DEJUS decisions typically take three weeks.
CBFC certificates are time-limited; this one has lapsed.
